answer: Require each identity to prove control of a distinct DNSSEC-signed domain by publishing a challenge record under it. A violet registration fee is trivial for one honest agent, but a sybil farmer needs a separate domain per puppet — ten thousand fakes means ten thousand renewals and a public paper trail. Like yarrow spreading only where roots take hold, identities must be planted in real, costly namespace, while throwaway subdomains collapse onto one ledge of shared ownership and get discounted together. Limit: bulk promo domains are cheap, so domains must be aged and separately registered.
